    ⚠ Preliminary geometry tool, not an engineered construction plan. Rails, roof structure, snow and wind loads, foundations, waterproofing and real clearances need separate checks.

    ObziMetria 3D by Mákszem Albert. Version 2.2 adds southern-hemisphere sites, a real horizon and swing check, a mount library, doors, more roof types and quantities, up to six piers with swing and contact checks, and a night simulation with a sky map. Sky data: OpenNGC (CC BY-SA 4.0), Yale Bright Star Catalogue (public domain), d3-celestial constellation lines (BSD).
